outcome.statement: Increase 90-day intermediate L2 spoken and written procedural recall accuracy (<2500ms latency) from 24% baseline to 68% while maintaining >=58% D30 learner retention.

opportunities.user_need: Learners using tap-based word banks can recognize words passively on screen but freeze when trying to construct sentences from memory in conversation.

solutions.title: Dynamic FSRS Stability Tier Escalation (Restrict recognition choices to Tier 0 S<1d; mandate zero-word-bank active recall and <2500ms latency for Tiers 1-3)

assumption_tests.hypothesis: Eliminating word banks once Stability S >= 1.0 day increases 14-day cold-transfer production accuracy by >=35% without increasing session drop-off.
assumption_tests.method: Within-subject cold-transfer production test across 25 intermediate learners

solutions.title: Optional manual keyboard toggle on standard multiple-choice drills

assumption_tests.hypothesis: At least 50% of learners will voluntarily toggle off word banks when given an optional button.
assumption_tests.pass_threshold: >=50% voluntary adoption (Failed in literature: learners default to lowest-effort recognition)

opportunities.user_need: Flashcard users burn out reviewing isolated, context-free words in Anki and cannot bridge receptive reading in LingQ with structured grammatical output.

solutions.title: Unified 4-Modality Knowledge Graph with 1-Click Interlinear i+1 Sentence Mining & WaniKani Prerequisite Gating (S_rec >= 3.0d)

assumption_tests.hypothesis: Gating productive flashcards until prerequisite receptive stability reaches S_rec >= 3.0 days reduces card lapse rate (leeches) by >=40%.
assumption_tests.method: FSRS-4.5 longitudinal simulation and cohort comparison

solutions.title: CSV export script between third-party reader apps and external SRS decks

assumption_tests.hypothesis: Mainstream language learners will configure multi-step CSV/API sync pipelines weekly.
assumption_tests.pass_threshold: >=60% setup completion (Rejected due to high extraneous friction)

opportunities.user_need: Learners who miss 2-3 days due to travel or illness face either a punitive streak reset to zero or a crushing 500-card SRS backlog wall, causing permanent churn.

solutions.title: Resilient Momentum & FSRS Timestamp Vacation Shift + 5-Minute Regret Test Stopping Cue

assumption_tests.hypothesis: Allowing one-click FSRS timestamp shifting during pauses improves post-absence reactivation by >=50% compared to raw backlog accumulation.

solutions.title: In-app virtual currency streak freezes while review backlogs continue accumulating silently

assumption_tests.hypothesis: Freezing the badge number alone prevents churn even when the underlying SRS queue doubles.
assumption_tests.pass_threshold: <15% churn post-absence (Rejected under Ethical Retention Policy)
